parameters.name: AddAccount
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which to share the destination image through image sharing. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: AdvancedOptions
parameters.description: The advanced configuration.

parameters.name: BaseImage
parameters.description: The source image.

parameters.name: BaseImageType
parameters.description: The type of the source image. Valid values:

parameters.name: BuildContent
parameters.description: The content of the image build template. The content size cannot exceed 16 KB. For information about supported commands, see [Commands supported by Image Builder](~~200206~~).

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: DeleteInstanceOnFailure
parameters.description: Specifies whether to release the intermediate instance if the image build fails. Valid values:

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: ImageFamily
parameters.description: The destination image family.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The prefix of the destination image name.

parameters.name: ImageOptions
parameters.description: The destination image properties.

parameters.name: ImportImageOptions
parameters.description: The properties and settings for importing the image. This parameter is required when `BaseImageType=OSS`.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type. You can call [DescribeInstanceTypes](~~25620~~) to query available instance types.

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The outbound public bandwidth of the intermediate instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The template name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NvmeSupport
parameters.description: Specifies whether the destination image supports NVMe.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RepairMode
parameters.description: The repair options in the image template.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise resource group.

parameters.name: SystemDiskSize
parameters.description: The system disk size of the intermediate instance. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 500.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TestContent
parameters.description: The content of the image test template. The content size cannot exceed 16 KB. For information about supported commands, see [Commands supported by Image Builder](~~200206~~).

parameters.name: ToRegionId
parameters.description: The regions to which to distribute the destination image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the VPC.
